raw_answer_text:
A1: Broadcast — the request goes out to every host on the LAN (destination MAC ff:ff:ff:ff:ff:ff).
A2: NOT STATED (the file only shows that A's cache has no entry for B's IP before the exchange, not why).
A3: NOT STATED
A4: No — other hosts on the LAN "heard" the broadcast but it is labeled "ignored."
A5: Unicast — sent directly only to the requesting host (Host A).
A6: A caches the information; its table entry becomes B's IP → aa:bb:cc:..., learned from the reply.
A7: The request is meant to obtain B's hardware address — A asks "who-has B?" and only after the reply does A learn and cache B's MAC.
A8: NOT STATED
